desc: Implement DSU with path compression and union by size, tracking component count.
Map each input value `<= threshold` to its index and initialize the component count to `n`.
For every active value `x`, scan multiples `x, 2x, ..., threshold`; store or union the representative associated with each multiple.
Leave values greater than `threshold` as isolated components.
Return the final DSU component count and verify both sample cases.
